frozen_tuple.chrome_profile_directory: Default (read from Chrome Local State profile.last_used)

limitations: The guard was not demonstrated gating a UI.Vision macro because the permitted actuator surface is unavailable.
The target tab-to-running-Chrome-process association is not independently exposed.
Qualification-only external preflight; not a production browser supervisor.
Chrome may drift because Google Updater services are installed and a GoogleUpdater scheduled task is Ready.
UI.Vision may drift through Chrome extension update behavior; updates were not claimed disabled.
The guard rereads the live executable and extension manifest on every invocation, so it detects rather than prevents drift.
The friendly profile name friendsenc and RealUser V2026 remain user-reported.
Legacy XModules 3.2.3 is an additional component and is not conflated with Desktop Automation v2.0.12.
